response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong backend and distributed-systems expertise, including event-driven architecture and microservices, as well as hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure (e.g., MCP code generators). However, his background lacks direct experience with multi-agent AI systems in production, fintech infrastructure, or regulated environments. His leadership experience is also limited to engineering roles rather than executive-level scalability.
strengths: Strong distributed-systems and event-driven architecture experience (e.g., GISCollective, Dunnhumby)
Recent work on AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling (MCP, agentic workflows)
Proven scalability in engineering teams and systems (e.g., Dunnhumby, Optilyz)
concerns: No direct experience with multi-agent AI systems in production or financial applications
Limited exposure to fintech infrastructure (e.g., credit systems, payment flows)
Lacks executive-level leadership experience (e.g., scaling teams beyond 30+ engineers)

key_factors.factor: Executive leadership in scaling engineering teams
